summary: Target Corporation filed an 8-K to report entry into a new $4.0 billion unsecured five-year revolving credit facility with Bank of America as administrative agent, replacing its prior $3.0 billion five-year facility and a $1.0 billion 364-day facility. The new agreement expires August 14, 2031, with extension options and an accordion feature. Terms are customary, including a leverage ratio covenant. This is a routine refinancing of credit facilities, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are involved.
